facts.fact: CRASA's provisional programme schedules the G5 Summit 2026 in Lilongwe, Malawi on 13-15 April 2026, with a session on advancing the SADC Single Digital Market and adoption of the Lilongwe Declaration on the last day; the document has no date of its own and is dated here by its March 2026 upload path.
